caption: Figure 9.3: Absorbing layers on unstructured scattering meshes. Left: truncating a cylindrical or spherical wave with a Cartesian box PML produces oblique incidence and impedance mismatches in the four corners. Right: Wakis's annular / spherical radial CFS-PML stretches the radial coordinate r and integrated cylindrical phase r̃ smoothly across the outer ring r ∈ [r_pml, R_outer], matching the outgoing wavefronts everywhere to achieve < 0.2% reflection.
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G, incident waves, and Wakis-recommended boundaries in blue; dual grid G-tilde, phase-shifted/auxiliary quantities, and secondary items in orange; exact/topological/reference items in dark grey; matched absorbing/material items in green; spurious reflection, corner mismatch, or warning items in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Two square panels side by side. LEFT PANEL headed in red 'Cartesian box PML on outgoing circular wave': a central scatterer (grey circle) surrounded by an unstructured triangle mesh inside a square PML frame. Concentric blue circular wavefronts expand radially from the centre; where the circular wavefronts meet the four square corners of the box PML, mark red warning zones with reflected red ripples labelled 'corner impedance mismatch'. RIGHT PANEL headed in green 'Radial CFS-PML on unstructured mesh': the same central scatterer surrounded by a Delaunay triangle mesh (blue edges) inside r < r_pml, enclosed by a concentric annular green ring 'r ∈ [r_pml, R_outer]' of thickness 'pml_thickness'. The circular blue wavefronts enter the annular ring perpendicularly at every azimuth (small right-angle marks between radial arrows and wavefront circles) and fade smoothly across the ring. Below the right panel, display the complex radial coordinate stretch equation exact to the manual: 'r̃ = r + (1 / iωε₀) ∫_{r_pml}^r σ(ρ) dρ' and two short badges: orange '2 auxiliary state variables per edge/cell' and green '< 0.2% reflection on UnstructuredFIT2D, PolygonFIT2D, PrismFIT3D, UnstructuredFIT3D'.
target_diagram_desc0:
The figure is a textbook-quality scientific schematic in a flat vector style, designed with high contrast, thin dark outlines, and generous whitespace on a pure white background. It strictly employs a colorblind-safe palette mapping semantic meaning to color: primary grids and outgoing waves are blue; auxiliary quantities and badges are orange; central scatterers are dark grey; absorbing material regions and optimal results are green; and spurious reflections or mismatch warnings are red. All text is rendered in a clear sans-serif font. The diagram is divided into two square panels side-by-side, with an equation and badge section positioned below the right panel.

**Left Panel:**
*   **Header:** Positioned at the top in red text is the heading: 'Cartesian box PML on outgoing circular wave'. 
*   **Central Elements:** In the center is a solid dark grey circle representing the central scatterer. Surrounding this scatterer is a standard unstructured triangle mesh constructed with thin dark outlines. 
*   **Boundary & Waves:** The mesh is enclosed within a rigid square frame representing the Cartesian box PML. Expanding outward from the central scatterer are concentric blue circular lines representing the outgoing wavefronts. 
*   **Error Visualization:** Where the blue circular wavefronts intersect the four 90-degree corners of the square PML box, there are prominent red warning zones. Emanating inwards from these four corners are red rippling lines to illustrate spurious reflections. A red label, 'corner impedance mismatch', is positioned near these ripples.

**Right Panel:**
*   **Header:** Positioned at the top in green text is the heading: 'Radial CFS-PML on unstructured mesh'.
*   **Central Elements:** Identical to the left panel, a solid dark grey circle sits in the center. It is surrounded by a Delaunay triangle mesh, but here the mesh edges are drawn in blue to signify the primary grid, filling a circular region defined by radius $r < r_{\text{pml}}$.
*   **Boundary & Waves:** Enclosing this circular blue mesh is a thick, concentric annular ring filled with a solid, light green color. This region is labeled '$r \in [r_{\text{pml}}, R_{\text{outer}}]$'. A dimension line crossing the width of the green ring is labeled 'pml_thickness'. Concentric blue circular wavefronts expand outward from the center. Small dark grey right-angle (perpendicular) marks are placed exactly where the radial wave arrows intersect the circular boundary, indicating the waves enter the green annular ring perfectly perpendicular at every azimuth. Inside the green ring, the blue wavefronts smoothly fade out (lowering in opacity) to depict perfect absorption.

**Bottom Section (Below Right Panel):**
*   **Equation:** Centered below the right panel is the complex radial coordinate stretch equation, cleanly typeset with the exact notation: 'r̃ = r + (1 / iωε₀) ∫_{r_pml}^r σ(ρ) dρ'.
*   **Badges:** Beneath the equation are two short, horizontal rectangular badges:
    *   The first badge is styled in orange (either orange text or orange outline/fill) with the text: '2 auxiliary state variables per edge/cell'.
    *   The second badge is styled in green (either green text or green outline/fill) with the text: '< 0.2% reflection on UnstructuredFIT2D, PolygonFIT2D, PrismFIT3D, UnstructuredFIT3D'.
